records.description: Use laser-cooled Cs133 and Rb87 atoms in their electronic ground states in the source fountain ensemble: Cs fountains FO1/FOM and a dual fountain DF operated alternately with Rb and Cs. Select mF=0 clock levels with microwave/laser pulses after0.3-0.6 s cooling and upward launch. Record overlapping fountain data within a few minutes to suppress shared-maser fluctuations, while keeping DF alternation and campaign-specific preparations.

contexts.finding: The selected Na(110) energy-momentum map shows a dispersing occupied intensity feature approaching the Fermi level. The source near-Fermi map is nearly circular in the assigned kx-ky plane, with reported ky Fermi wave vector about 0.91 inverse Angstrom. A separate photon-energy scan fitted in Appendix A yields an average about 0.88 inverse Angstrom and maximum near 69 eV photons; these are separate reported cuts/assignments, not a single exact universal radius. Fitting the same source ARPES data, shown over the reported 0.103-2.263 eV energy interval, to a finite-resolution spectral function with E(k)=W-gamma1*k^2-gamma2*k^4 gives the occupied bandwidth W=2.78 eV. Comparing with the supplied LDA bandwidth W_LDA=3.18 eV gives the source parabolic-band mass-renormalization estimate m*/m0=1.14. The inferred occupied quasiparticle bandwidth is not the cohesive energy per atom, and the LDA comparison is not a second independent experimental acquisition.

The preparation is a finite sodium film on tungsten. Near-circularity does not establish a perfectly spherical free-electron surface for every material, phase, pressure or temperature; orientation and calibration are explicit alternatives for small deviations.

The 0.91 and 0.88 inverse-Angstrom values come from different cuts/fits and are not silently equated. The kz assignment uses a photoelectron final-state convention; no independent carrier-density or electron-per-atom reconstruction is supplied.

The occupied bandwidth and mass inference reuse the same data and supplied LDA reference. No new independent experiment, raw spectral refit, numerical precision beyond the source, conductivity, thermal-current or mechanical measurement is claimed.

records.description: For a localized neutral molecular charge distribution in SI units, p=integral(rho(r)*r*d^3r) is an electric dipole moment in C m and does not depend on the coordinate origin. A state-specific body-fixed permanent moment can coexist with a zero laboratory vector average. Define electronic induced response at fixed state/geometry by delta p_i=alpha_ij*E_local,j to leading order; alpha_ij has SI units C m^2/V. Electronic deformation and field-dependent rotational orientation are separate contributions. A fixed dipole has field energy -p dot E; a reversible linear induced dipole has energy -(p dot E)/2.
